title: Youth unemployment crisis
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why can young people remain unemployed even when they have degrees or qualifications?
Should governments focus more on creating jobs or on improving young people's skills?
How long should a graduate be willing to wait for a job in their preferred field before changing direction?
Does unpaid work experience help young people enter the labour market, or exploit them?
If you were unemployed for a year, what would you do to keep your skills and motivation strong?
